description: The matrix decoder succeeds exactly on codes of shared quantifier-free formulas at the required placeholder depth.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.readMatrix_recognition (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ)
  (depth e : ℕ) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.readMatrix c arities depth e).isSome = true ↔
    ∃ φ,
      φ.IsQF ∧
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.formulaCode
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.signature c arities) Empty.elim φ =
          e
